Gen 7 prototype: tree search and a fork-pair bench to score it

bridge_harness/gen7_tree.py: a few tricks played from each seat's own view
before double dummy. Other seats' cards come from the policy net given what
that seat sees in the layout; the decider's own later card is one choice for
every layout that looks the same to it; DDS at the end of the horizon. With
the horizon at zero it is PIMC exactly (tested).

scripts/gen7_bench.py: rebuilds each gap-fork (and tie-audit) position and
credits an evaluator with what the forked card really gained when it prefers
that card. Gen 6 scores zero by construction.

First results are not in the write-up yet: the two-trick tree as built does
not beat Gen 6 from trick 3 on.
